messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 pager — high 429s from inference gateway in us-west-2, GPU pools reporting 100% utilization and queue depth rising. Alert: gpu-cluster-saturating. Escalation: keiko on-call.
keiko: picking up. looking at dashboards now. rough numbers?
maria: seeing a spike at 14:03 UTC — sustained token inflight ~18k, hotpath queue growth 4x baseline, node GPU mem ~98% on hot pools. autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts rejected (max_pools reached).
keiko: got it. can we confirm autoscale max_pools value and current pool count?
maria: config shows max_pools=12 for us-west-2-hot, current active_pools=12, pending_scale_requests=3, backoff preventing new pool creation.
keiko: that matches. sounds like capacity limit + tokenbucket tiering causing cascade of 429s. which tier is hitting token bucket?
sam: tier-mapping shows tier 'realtime' routed to hot pools and has token_bucket burst_cap=5000 and refill=1000/s. During surge, per-customer bursts drained fast and token returns are rate-limited, causing 429s upstream.
keiko: @sam can you temporarily increase burst_cap for realtime to 15k and increase refill to 3k/s while we stabilize? also lift strict per-route enforcement to allow fallback to warm pools for non-low-latency routes. make the change via infra-config so it's auditable.
sam: applying change now (will push to staging config then prod) — command:
```
infractl set tokenbucket --env=prod --region=us-west-2 --tier=realtime --burst=15000 --refill=3000
```
ryan: note: support already seeing customer reports about elevated latency and 429s since 14:02 UTC, about 12 customers affected, highest-impact customers are two mid-market accounts with large batch requests. they need ETA.
keiko: estimating mitigation time 5-8 minutes after config change hits. will do canary then roll. @maria watch queue delta and 429 rate.
maria: canary applied to one AZ, metrics look better: queue depth down ~30% in canary, 429s per sec reduced from 220 to 70. rolling to rest of AZs now.
keiko: also enabling soft-fallback routing to warm pools for requests marked "best_effort" to drain backlog — command:
```
routerctl update-route --region=us-west-2 --policy=fallback:warmpool --match=route.tags:best_effort
```
sam: warm pools are at ~70% but have spare capacity for best_effort traffic. rolling both changes now.
keiko: monitoring. if we don't see improvement in 10m we should consider temporarily increasing max_pools to 16 and lifting autoscaler backoff. can we change max_pools quickly?
maria: max_pools is an infra variable. I can patch it to 16 but it requires a short maintenance window for autoscaler restart (~40s). timeline: 3 minutes to patch, restart autoscaler, pools should spin up ~2-4 minutes.
keiko: do it, proceed. communicate to oncall channel before restart.
maria: patching now: `infracfg set --path=/clusters/us-west-2/hot/max_pools --value=16 && infractl restart autoscaler --cluster=us-west-2-hot`
keiko: autoscaler restart queued. ryansupport, please update affected customers: "We're applying targeted capacity and routing changes to mitigate elevated 429s; expected recovery in ~10 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause and prevention."
ryan: sending update now.
ben: any immediate customer-side workarounds they can do? e.g., reduce concurrency or retry backoff?
keiko: recommend increasing client-side exponential backoff and jitter, and if possible route non-interactive batch jobs to a background endpoint (we have background-tier). We'll include those in message.
maria: autoscaler back up, new pools allocating. seeing 3 new hot instances come up, GPU capacity +20%. queue depth trending down, 429s now at 12/s.
keiko: good. keep changes in effect for now, we'll revert burst_cap/refill when traffic cools and then tune token bucket policies long-term. creating follow-up action items: 1) postmortem, 2) revisit max_pools safety margins, 3) tokenbucket per-customer caps, 4) automated emergency increase path.
keiko: marking incident as mitigated for customer impact. still monitoring for residual error dips.
oncall-bot: Incident annotated: mitigated=true, mitigation_window=14:03-14:17 UTC, pager_duration=14m. Please file postmortem in /incidents/postmortems within 48h.
ryan: customers notified with status update and estimated full recovery in 30m, will follow with RCA.
ben: thanks team — good call on fallback routing. let's be sure postmortem captures why autoscaler backoff prevented scaling earlier and whether tokenbucket defaults are too conservative. :thumbsup:
keiko: agreed. closing thread for active mitigation; will re-open if 429s climb back above 50/s.
